title: Asset pipeline decisions (opt-in image downloads, redirect refusal) are implemented; ready to close
blocker: Codex, high: image downloads off by default, enabled by an options-page control that requests `https://*/*` once; redirects whose target Chrome hides are refused and recorded. Codex, medium: build the pipeline after the phase 2 real-browser smoke check.
notes: 2026-11-24 audit: Both decisions are implemented, so the blocker (build after phase 2 smoke check) is stale. Evidence: src/options/toggle-download-images.ts requests chrome.permissions {origins:[https://*/*]}; src/manifest.json lists it under optional_host_permissions; src/background/assets/images-enabled.ts gates on permissions.contains (off by default); commits 528d382 (vet URLs and redirects), a4ee720 (download images when option on), plus hardening c5d1bbc, e54cee9, fc1ac4b; tests/background/assets/*. Closed sibling tasks cover the phase 3 security review. Left: nothing; close it.
result: Asset pipeline decisions (opt-in image downloads, redirect refusal) are implemented; ready to close
